קיז.ja: ומן אעג'ב מא יקע עליה בצר אלאנסאן מן מכ'לוקאת אלבארי תעאלי אלג'סימה פהי אלסמא,
קיז.en: Among the most wondrous of the corporeal creatures of the Creator (exalted be He) upon which the sight of man falls is the heaven,

pairs.en: upon which the sight of man falls
creatures of the Creator (exalted be He)

קיז.ja: פאנה חית' וקף מן אלארץ' ירי נצף אלפלך אלד'י יחיט באלארץ',
קיז.en: for wherever he stands upon the earth he sees half of the sphere that surrounds the earth,

pairs.en: he sees half of the sphere

קיז.ja: פאד'א נט'ר אלנאט'ר אליה מעתברא ראי אן אלד'י כ'לקה במשייתה לא יתנאהי פי קדרתה וחכמתה וג'לאלתה,
קיז.en: and when the observer looks upon it reflectively, he sees that the One who created it by His will is without limit in His power, His wisdom, and His majesty;

pairs.en: and when the observer looks upon it
that the One who created it by His will
in His power, His wisdom, and His majesty

קיז.ja: פאנא אד'א ארינא מן את'אר בניאן אלכ'לק אלקדים שיא תעג'בנא מן קדרתהם עלי מת'לה,
קיז.en: for when we are shown something of the traces of the buildings of the ancients, we marvel at their capacity for the like of it,

pairs.en: something of the traces of the buildings of the ancients
at their capacity for the like of it

קיז.ja: ודלנא עלי קוהֵ אבדאנהם ועלו הממהם פי תחצינהם עלי אנפסהם,
קיז.en: and it points us to the strength of their bodies and the loftiness of their resolve in fortifying themselves;

pairs.en: to the strength of their bodies
and the loftiness of their resolve

קיז.ja: פאד'א עט'ם עלינא הד'א אלנזר אליסיר ואלאת'ר אלחקיר אלד'י לא יפצ'ל עלי עמלנא אלא באליסיר,
קיז.en: so when this slight glance and paltry trace—which exceeds our own work only by a little—looms great in our eyes,

pairs.ja: אלד'י לא יפצ'ל עלי עמלנא אלא באליסיר
pairs.en: which exceeds our own work only by a little

קיז.ja: כם יג'ב אן יעט'ם מן כ'אלק אלארץ' ואלסמא ומא בינהמא דון כלפה ולא משקה ולא נצב ולא ענא,
קיז.en: how much more ought there to loom great the Maker of the earth and the heaven and what is between them—without effort, without toil, without weariness, without travail,

pairs.en: how much more ought there to loom great
the Maker of the earth and the heaven

קיז.ja: ולא מן שי ולא עלי שי ולא בשי, בל באראדתה ומשייתה,
קיז.en: neither out of anything, nor upon anything, nor by anything, but rather by His will and His volition,

pairs.en: but rather by His will and His volition

קיז.ja: כקולה בדבר ה' שמים נעשו וברוח פיו כל צבאם.
קיז.en: as in His saying: "By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of His mouth" (Psalms 33:6).

pairs.en: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made
and all their host by the breath of His mouth

קיז.ja: ומן ג'מלהֵ אלנעם עלי אלאנסאן אן כלמא תאמלת את'אר אלחכמה פי אלמכ'לוקין תג'דהא מע שהאדתהא ללכ'אלק תעאלי באלרבוביה ואלוחדאניה לא תנפך מן אן יכון פיהא ללאנסאן וג'ה מנפעה וקצד מצלחה,
קיז.en: And among the sum of the favors toward man is that, whenever you reflect upon the traces of wisdom in created things, you find them—together with their witness to the Creator (exalted be He) of His lordship and His oneness—never devoid of there being in them, for man, some aspect of benefit and some intent of welfare,

pairs.en: And among the sum of the favors toward man
upon the traces of wisdom in created things
together with their witness to the Creator (exalted be He)
of His lordship and His oneness
of there being in them, for man

קיז.ja: אלא אן בעצ'הא ואצ'חה ובעצ'הא כ'פייה.
קיז.en: except that some of it is clear and some of it is hidden.

pairs.en: and some of it is hidden

קיז.ja: ומן ד'לך אלנור ואלט'למה, פאן פואיד אלנור ט'אהרה באדיה לא תכ'פו,
קיז.en: An instance of this is light and darkness: for the benefits of light are evident and apparent, not hidden,

קיז.ja: ואמא אלט'למה פכ'פייהֵ אלמנאפע, לאסתיחאש אלנאס בהא ואנקטאע אעמאלהם וחרכאתהם ענד חלולהא,
קיז.en: but as for darkness, its benefits are hidden, because of people's dread of it and the cessation of their labors and movements when it sets in;

pairs.en: because of people's dread of it
and the cessation of their labors and movements

קיז.ja: ולולא ט'למהֵ אלליל לאנקטעת אבדאן אכת'ר אלחיואן באתצאל תעבהא ודואם עמלהא וטול חרכתהא.
קיז.en: and were it not for the darkness of the night, the bodies of most animals would break down through the unbrokenness of their toil, the persistence of their labor, and the length of their movement.

pairs.en: and were it not for the darkness of the night
the bodies of most animals would break down
through the unbrokenness of their toil
and the length of their movement

קיז.ja: ובאלליל ינפצל בעץ' אלזמאן מן בעצ'ה, ובה תחצל אלמדד אלמג'הולה וטול אלאג'אל מן קצרהא.
קיז.en: And by the night one part of time is set off from another, and by it are determined the unknown durations and the length of life-spans as against their shortness.

pairs.en: one part of time is set off from another
and the length of life-spans as against their shortness

קיז.ja: ולו כאנת אלחאל דאימה עלי צורה ואחדה לם תכן שריעה מצ'מנה בזמאן מת'ל אלסבת
קיז.en: And were the state to remain perpetually in a single form, there would be no commandment bound to a time, such as the Sabbath.

pairs.en: And were the state to remain perpetually
